1.consolidated_definition: Planta intertropical de hasta 2 m de altura, con hojas alternas ovado-circulares, inflorescencia formada por varias espigas y flores diminutas; sus semillas maduras se usan como revulsivo y sus raíces poseen propiedades diuréticas. (Piperaceae; Piper umbellatum)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tropical plant reaching a height of up to 2 m, with alternate ovate-circular leaves, inflorescence formed by several spikes and minute flowers; its mature seeds are used as an emetic and its roots possess diuretic properties. (Piperaceae; Piper umbellatum)
